nodes.name: Gemini AI Resume Analysis
nodes.notes: Set the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable in your n8n instance before running. No credential ID is embedded here by design.

nodes.name: Save Candidate to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Connect your Google Sheets OAuth2 credential manually. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your actual Sheet ID.

parameters.subject: ={{ "Congratulations " + $json.candidate_name + " - You've Been Shortlisted for " + $json.job_title }}
parameters.message:
="Dear " + $json.candidate_name + ",

" + "Congratulations! You have been shortlisted for the " + $json.job_title + " position.

" + "Overall Score: " + $json.candidate_score + "/100

" + "Matched Skills: " + $json.matched_skills.join(", ") + "

" + "Our team will contact you shortly with interview details.

" + "Best regards,
HireFlow AI Recruitment Team"

nodes.name: Send Shortlist Email
nodes.notes: Connect your Gmail OAuth2 credential manually.

nodes.name: Create Interview Event
nodes.notes: Connect your Google Calendar OAuth2 credential manually. Placeholder: schedules interview 5 days from now at 11:00 AM. Adjust as needed.

parameters.subject: ={{ "Interview Confirmation - " + $json.job_title }}
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $json.candidate_name }},

This confirms your interview has been scheduled for the {{ $json.job_title }} position. A calendar invite has been sent to this email address with the date, time, and meeting details.

Please reach out if you need to reschedule.

Best regards,
HireFlow AI Recruitment Team

nodes.name: Send Interview Confirmation
nodes.notes: Connect your Gmail OAuth2 credential manually.

parameters.subject: ={{ "Follow-Up: Your Upcoming Interview for " + $json.job_title }}
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $json.candidate_name }},

This is a friendly reminder regarding your upcoming interview for the {{ $json.job_title }} position. Please make sure to check your calendar invite for the exact date and time.

If you have any questions or need to reschedule, feel free to reply to this email.

We look forward to speaking with you.

Best regards,
HireFlow AI Recruitment Team

nodes.name: Send Follow-Up Reminder
nodes.notes: Connect your Gmail OAuth2 credential manually.

parameters.subject: ={{ "Application Update - " + $json.job_title }}
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $json.candidate_name }},

Thank you for applying for the {{ $json.job_title }} position. We wanted to let you know that your application is currently under review by our hiring team.

We will notify you as soon as a decision has been made regarding the next steps.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
HireFlow AI Recruitment Team

nodes.name: Send Review Email
nodes.notes: Connect your Gmail OAuth2 credential manually.

parameters.subject: ={{ "Application Update - " + $json.job_title }}
parameters.message:
=Dear {{ $json.candidate_name }},

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the {{ $json.job_title }} position and for sharing your experience with us.

After careful review, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose qualifications more closely match our current requirements. This decision is not a reflection of your abilities, and we encourage you to apply for future opportunities with us.

We wish you the best in your job search and future endeavors.

Best regards,
HireFlow AI Recruitment Team

nodes.name: Send Rejection Email
nodes.notes: Connect your Gmail OAuth2 credential manually.
